mechanics.claim: Vel'Koz can hold up to 2 charges of Void Rift, each consuming its own mana cost, allowing rapid back-to-back casts beyond the base cooldown.
mechanics.quote: '''Vel'Koz''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Void Rift'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

mechanics.claim: Void Rift deals two separate damage instances (initial opening and later collapse), each of which can be blocked by a spell shield only once total, not once per instance.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Windwall/Unbreakable can block the ripple missile and stop the rift from forming further along its path, though the already-formed section still deals damage.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} and {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} will block the ripple and prevent the rift from forming further, but they will not destroy the section that was created already.
